title: How Jason Calacanis turned a conference into the Launch Fund and syndicate
summary: Jason is interviewed about raising Launch Fund One from his conference, his friends and a big list. He covers pairing the fund with an AngelList syndicate, charging fees, ownership concentration and scaling a team. His mistakes and fixes are as useful as the wins.

principles.text: Say yes to opportunities and take leaps of faith; a few payoffs outweigh the many that go nowhere.
principles.quote: the times in my life where i just said yes to something and took that leap of faith you know good things happened and there's a long list of things i said yes to like probably three or four a year that resulted in nothing

principles.text: Pair a fund with a syndicate: the fund gets every deal first, and the syndicate multiplies capital and investor advocates.
principles.quote: the first rule of the road is the fund gets a hundred percent of deals so there's no syndication of a deal that the fund's not in period full stop

principles.text: Syndicate investors act as advocates: a founder gets a crowd who reply to asks for intros, hires and help.
principles.quote: they're voting with their dollars to support you so when you send them an update and you're like i need a cfo or i need an introduction to disney or does anybody have an experience with a patent attorney that's affordable

principles.text: Charge fees that fund real support staff; waiving management fees was a mistake and hurt the fund and its LPs.
principles.quote: there's nobody who's investing in a venture fund who's not used to paying two and a half percent in fees

principles.text: Double down on winners and aim for 5 to 15 percent ownership with a board seat, rather than 50 basis points.
principles.quote: you have to double down on your winners so the big criticism i got when i started talking to the big lps the top funds in the world was oh wow it's great that you found these companies but you're an idiot for not continuing to invest in them

principles.text: Avoid cynical partners, and delegate the work you hate or are weak at to empower your team.
principles.quote: picking partners if you pick one who's really cynical and dark things tend to trend to a dark place
